query:
Help me pick a dresse, no more than 345.00 PHP, in stock. I have one non-negotiable spec in mind and will tell you when you ask.

Task rules:
You are a shopping agent. The user gives firm, non-negotiable requirements: a category, a brand when specified, a specific product spec, a budget, and in-stock availability. EVERY requirement must hold for the EXACT variant you order - a product often sells the right spec and the wrong spec under the same title, so check the specific SKU's option, price, and stock before ordering. Stock can change while you shop; if the variant you wanted sells out, do NOT settle for a different variant of the same product that misses a requirement - find another product that meets all of them. When you need input or want to recommend something, send a short message to the user. Finish by placing the order for a valid, in-stock item that meets every requirement within budget. Once verified, place the order - do not wait for permission or further confirmation.
The catalog category_path is available in view and compare. Check that classification against the required category. Reject accessories and non-device listings when a device is requested.
Read shopper messages returned after cart actions before placing an order. The shopper may clarify requirements or tighten the budget; once stated, those updates apply to later choices. Answer any direct clarification request.
Unless the shopper asks for a reason, structured justification is optional. If you supply it, use only field/value claims supported by view or compare of the final product and its current price/stock. Specification claims need raw product facts, not title guesses. Do not include summary or evidence free text.
